JPN.hook: Nearly 14,000 islands, and three quarters of the land is mountain — almost everyone is packed onto the coastal fringe.
JPN.place: The arc of islands off the Asian mainland, east of the Korean peninsula.

KOR.hook: Went from one of the world's poorest countries to one of its richest inside a single lifetime — the fastest such climb on record.
KOR.place: The southern half of the Korean peninsula, facing Japan across a narrow strait.

PRK.hook: The 4km-wide strip separating it from the South has been left alone so long it has become an accidental wildlife refuge.
PRK.place: The northern half of the Korean peninsula, bordering China along the Yalu river.
